name: Tiny MLP for Density and Color Estimation
definition: A small Multi-Layer Perceptron that nonlinearly maps the Ripmap-Encoding feature vector f and the view direction d to the density τ and color c of the sampled sphere S.
summary: The Tiny MLP is a lightweight neural network in Rip-NeRF that estimates density and view-dependent color using a fixed-width architecture, distinguishing itself by dedicated prediction rather than texture lookups.
